name: SDIT Monthly SLA — First Response, Resolution, Recurrents, FCR, Time to Scale

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: =project = SDIT AND type = "[System] Incident" AND cf[11006] = "Sistemes" AND created >= "{{ $('Calculate Month Range').first().json.monthStart }}" AND created <= "{{ $('Calculate Month Range').first().json.monthEnd }}"

parameters.name: jql
